amount.description: What the refund settles of the credit, in its currency: at most what is left of it (APPLY-05).

credit_id.description: The credit refunded: an issued credit note, or a customer receipt with an amount unapplied.

fx_rate.description: For a credit in another currency refunded from an account in that currency: base currency per one unit, as on the bank's advice. Left out, the cascade's rate for the date (ENG-40).

money_account_id.description: The bank, card or wallet account it left: an active money account in the credit's currency or in the base currency.

paid.description: For a credit in another currency refunded from a base-currency account: what the account paid, in the base currency. Required then, and only then (LEDGER-27).
